messages:
maria: Quick design check — pushed a compact version of the min/max + burst row for the pool optimizer. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx/pool-optimizer-v2. Two quick questions: 1) is the burst toggle affordance readable in compact mode? 2) SLO slider helper text — should it live inline or be an info tooltip? samir: I skimmed it. Nice compactness. Concern: the burst pill is pretty close to the min number input — easy to mis-click when trying to adjust min. Maybe separate it with a 8px gap or turn it into a smaller switch. Also keyboard focus needs clear styles. :mag: kelly: Agree with samir — also microcopy tweak: instead of "Burst capacity" consider "Short-term burst" or "Burst (temporary)" — gives clearer expectation. Inline :thinking: aj (PM): From product POV: default min should be 1 for latency-sensitive pools (we've already seen customers confused by min=0). Also how will the cost preview update if burst is enabled? We should show a baseline + burst delta. zoe (A11y): A few accessibility nits I ran into: the blue knob color currently fails AA at typical contrast sizes — needs darker tone (suggest #0B66D0). Slider needs aria-valuetext with units (e.g., "10 GPUs"), and keyboard steps should be 1 (arrow) and 10 (page). Also add aria-describedby pointing to the helper text node. samir (FE): I'll implement the a11y props and focus ring. Draft CSS/snippet below for the slider and pill role: ```html
/* focus */ .burst-toggle:focus, .slider:focus { outline: 3px solid rgba(11,102,208,0.15); } ``` samir: Also adding a 12px gap between min input and burst toggle in compact row to avoid click overlap. maria: Nice. For the cost delta, can we show a micro inline tag: "+~$3/hr (burst)" next to the pool name when burst is on? On mobile maybe hide the delta behind a tooltip. aj (PM): Yes show inline on desktop, tooltip on mobile. Also mobile: consider putting the burst toggle in an "Advanced" collapse to keep the primary flow simple. kelly: I'll prototype 2 copy variants for the pill: "Burst (temporary)" vs "Short-burst" and prepare an A/B test plan in Figma notes. zoe (A11y): One more: when burst is not available for a pool, the UI should render a disabled state with an explanation link ("No burst capacity available in this region"). Use aria-disabled and visually dimmed colors (do not rely on color alone). designbot (bot): Preview deploy queued — branch: pool-optimizer-v2, preview URL: https://preview.redwood.work/pool-optimizer-v2 (deploy scheduled at 1719238800). maria: Thanks everyone — action items: samir implement focus/aria and spacing; kelly produce copy variants and small mobile collapse; zoe will write the accessible states doc; aj will confirm default min=1 for latency pools. Back in 24h for another pass. :thumbsup:
